text: Yuwei Ha Feng regards the Vampire Lair at [[col:green]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:FirstTargetName}}[[/col]] and the bloodsucker slumbering within with open contempt.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]"Eternal unlife is granted by the Yin and by the will of Harakhte. Not by this... barbarian blood!"[[/col]]\\n\\nThe lair has been torn down to its foundations, and the treasures its master hoarded have been rendered into Dark Magic for the Dynasty.
